## Meeting intelligence built into every deal

Introducing Nova, Pipedrive’s latest feature. It captures what matters before, during and after every call and keeps your CRM up to date, right inside Pipedrive.

- **Briefed before:** Nova automatically pulls deal history and previous conversations into a pre-call brief. You always know exactly where things left off and what you need to do next.
- **Focused during:** It records and transcribes your calls so you don’t have to. You stay in the conversation, and Nova takes care of the notes.
- **Updated after:** It generates a recap and drafts CRM updates you can review and approve in one click – no manual entry, no catching up.

[Try it free](https://app.pipedrive.com/nova-paywall)
[Find out more](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/nova)

Nova is included in all plans, at no additional cost.

### **Easily manage leads and deals**

Organize customer data and interactions in one simple tool and act fast when opportunity strikes.

- **Customize your pipelines**

Pipedrive’s kanban-style dashboard lets you visualize your sales funnel. Adjust your pipelines to your sales process and move deals along as they progress. We’ll notify you when you need to follow up.

- **Centralize your sales data and contact history**

Import data from spreadsheets or other pipeline management software in just a few clicks. Link products or services to deals to track negotiations and see the bigger picture.

- **Add custom fields**

Shape your CRM to your business with custom fields. Capture must-have info for your sales team and automate calculations with smart formulas.
